text:
Maya R: quick async standup — kernel + batching + KV perf preflight
Maya R: yesterday: wired up microbatch slotting fix and ran a 2k-request soak on canary. fewer stalls overall but saw a few microbursts.
Maya R: blocker: 95th latency spikes when KV eviction overlaps batch flush. need better traces to correlate.
Maya R: today: add eviction counters, enable `--kv-trace=1` behind an env flag, try bumping `--batch-max` to 24 on canary.

Oliver K: nice. can you paste the soak numbers? p50/p95?
Maya R: p50 ~ 18ms, p95 peaked ~210ms during warmup, later settled ~120ms after warm cache. attaching short log snippet in PR.
Jen O: my microbatch runs show batching + prefix cache reduced tokens/sec variance by ~12% :thumbsup:
Alex P: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/894 — added `--batch-max=24` and a debug flag.
Sahil: saw a suspicious line in logs earlier: `kv_evict: want=500 freed=0` — might be a refcount/race in the sweep.
Maya R: @Sahil can you try to repro with `KV_EVICT_DEBUG=1`? I'll add tracepoints around the sweep.
Sahil: will try now. suspect async sweep task scheduling starving the collector.
ci-bot: build/runtime-tests #894 failed on `bench_kv_warmup` (flaky test).
Alex P: rerunning CI now.
Alex P: rerun passed but bench p95 still borderline (~190ms) on the canary run.
Maya R: added extra eviction metrics (queue depth, attempted frees) and gated `--kv-trace=1` behind REDWOOD_KV_DEBUG so it won't spam prod.
Jen O: can we gate debug with env var + sample rate? don't want long-term noise.
Maya R: yep — adding `REDWOOD_KV_DEBUG_SAMPLER=0.01` default.
Oliver K: if p95 remains flaky after the fix, let's rollback `--batch-max` bump on canary and iterate.
Maya R: will open a rollback patch and keep instrumentation enabled for a second canary.
Sahil: local repro succeeded with `KV_WORKER=1` + heavy eviction. pushing a small fix to bump refcount before free.
Alex P: appreciated — if tests look stable after Sahil's fix, I'll run a 4k soak on canary tonight.
Maya R: thanks. I'll monitor traces and post a summary here.
Maya R: quick note: snippet of problematic log for context:
```
[2026-02-14T03:12:11Z] kv_evict: want=500 freed=0 pool=hot sweep_id=42
[2026-02-14T03:12:11Z] batch_flush: seq=9876 slots=18 duration_ms=34
[2026-02-14T03:12:11Z] kv_evict: attempt_free refcount=0 ptr=0x7f8b2c
```
Jen O: good capture. once Sahil's patch lands let's re-run the microbatch+cache variance bench.
Alex P: ping me if you want me to kick off the canary jobs. I can run them in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 to compare.
Maya R: will do. thanks all — will update thread when canary completes :rocket:
